facts.fact: NIMC director-general Abisoye Coker-Odusote said the NIMC Act 2026 designates NIMC as the National Root Certification Authority for Nigeria's public key infrastructure.

NGA.note: The document states no exchange between the civil register and the NIN system.

facts.fact: NIMC's director-general said the national register holds more than 140 million Nigerians and legal residents, about 59% of the 237.5 million population (share computed from the population held).

NGA.note: The document says nothing about a number given at birth.

facts.fact: NIMC director-general said the commission's own Self-Service Modification Platform had processed close to two million record updates, cutting turnaround from weeks to 24-48 hours.
Education minister Tunji Alausa said the ministry is seeking to link NIN information to education records covering 75-80 million students, to track pupils, students and teachers.
NIMC director-general said the national register now holds the identities of more than 140 million Nigerians and legal residents, enrolled through the Ward-to-Ward project in 8,809 wards.
